name: Oona, The Heartbroken
source:
For an ageless being with near limitless power, there was but one rule: Never involve yourself with the lives of mortals.

A bittersweet tale of love and tragedy - 'Oona, the Heartbroken' is the story of a lonely fairy who gave up everything to be with the human they loved, but can the rosy shores of romance endure the tempestuous tides of time?

[From [url=https://oonatempest.itch.io/oona-the-heartbroken]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于一个拥有近乎无限力量的永恒生物来说，只有一条规则：永远不要介入凡人的生活。

一个苦乐参半的爱情与悲剧故事——《伤心的乌娜》讲述了一位孤独的仙女为了与所爱的人在一起而放弃一切的故事，但浪漫的玫瑰色海岸能否经受住时间的惊涛骇浪？

[来自[url=https://oonatempest.itch.io/oona-the-heartbroken]itch.io[/url]]
